subject: Post-demo: proposed onramp & 4-week POC for Voltix Systems
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@voltix.com>, Michael Leung <michael.leung@voltix.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: proposed onramp & 4-week POC for Voltix Systems

Hi Sara / Michael — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed POC approach so we can align on scope and owners before a kickoff.

Demo highlights (brief)
- Ingest + vectorize: Redwood handles streaming ingestion from S3 and incremental embeddings.
- Latency profile: sub-250ms token generation in our dedicated configuration for the 2k context demo.
- Security: private deployment options, SOC 2 evidence available.

Proposed 4-week POC (goal: validate Voltix search relevancy and query latency with live logs)
Week 0 (prep) — data sample + access; Redwood provides integration checklist
Week 1 — ingestion, mapping, baseline metrics collection (relevancy and latency)
Week 2 — tuning (prompt templates, quantized model variant) + reranking test set
Week 3 — reliability & throughput test (parallel queries, cache hit analysis)
Week 4 — evaluation & handoff; success metric review and decision meeting

Success criteria (suggested)
- Median query latency < 300ms at 95th percentile under expected QPS
- Relevancy lift: +15% MRR over current keyword baseline on the core query set
- End-to-end throughput >= X qps with <1.5x cost delta vs current infra (TBD)

Suggested owners
- Redwood: Jonas Weber (AE) — engagement lead; Camila Reyes (SE) — technical lead
- Voltix: Sara Li — product lead; Michael Leung — infra/ops lead

Attachments: RDW-Voltix-POC-outline.pdf (POC plan, milestones, roles)
Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/voltix-poc-outline

Ask: Please confirm these owners, the success criteria above, and whether Voltix can provide ~100k sample log lines and a short security addendum (see SOC2 note below) before we lock a kickoff date. If that looks good, we propose a kickoff week of Feb 23.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m sync if you prefer to walk through this together.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

---
Redwood-POC-outline.pdf attached (1.7MB)

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear plan. High level, this aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications before we commit to Feb 23 kickoff: 

1) Data sample: we can provide 100–150k anonymized log lines. Will that be sufficient to validate relevancy?
2) Security: our security team will want the SOC2 report and a list of controls for data-at-rest and key management. Can you share the SOC2 and confirm KMS options?
3) Cost metric: when you say cost delta vs current infra, can you outline what data points Redwood needs to estimate that?

Also, Michael asked if Redwood can support an on-prem connector for the initial ingestion (we'd like to avoid egress for the sample). If possible, please outline that in the checklist.

If you want to jump on a quick call Monday to finalize, I'm available 9–11am PT.

Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed onramp & 4-week POC for Voltix Systems

Hi Sara — thanks, this is all workable. A few technical notes and an integration checklist to address Michael's on-prem connector question. I've attached a short spreadsheet with the fields we need.

Key notes:
- Data sample: 100–150k anonymized lines is perfect. We just need consistent IDs and timestamps. PII should be redacted; if you need help with a redaction script we can provide a small utility.
- On-prem connector: supported via SFTP or a temporary VPN tunnel into a restricted bucket. No persistent egress required. We'll provide a short runbook for the ops team and can scope a 1–day on-prem assist if needed.
- SOC2 & KMS: SOC2 Type II report link and our KMS integration options are included in the checklist. For the POC, clients typically use our managed KMS; if you require a customer-managed KMS we have a private deployment option.
- Cost estimate inputs: sample QPS, average query size (tokens), and retention window for embeddings. If you can share those three numbers we can provide a preliminary cost delta estimate by Tuesday.

Proposed milestones (concrete)
1) Prep & access (Day -2 to Day 0): data handoff, credentials, runbook review
2) Ingest & baseline (Days 1–5): ingestion, mapping, baseline metric capture
3) Tuning & validation (Days 6–14): prompt tuning, rerank tests, evaluation set
4) Load & reliability (Days 15–21): throughput testing and cache configuration
5) Review & handoff (Days 22–28): final metrics, decision meeting

If those milestones look good I can send a calendar invite for a Feb 23 kickoff and include the runbook and a short onboarding checklist.

Attachments: integration-checklist.xlsx

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
